gap.missing_evidence: The inspected primary source does not identify directly observed ED-eligible bed-offer events, an offer denominator, destination-specialty compatibility, offer persistence/expiry, or withdrawal times. It describes a ward-level simulation built from ED presentations, inpatient episodes, and patient ward-transfer movements at three principal referral hospitals. Those patient movements and ward-capacity records do not establish when a placement opportunity became eligible for a particular ED patient or how long such an opportunity remained available.
gap.owner: P1.1 coordinator and ED pathway/hospital-interface model owner; local bed-management data custodian to be identified
gap.impact: This source cannot supply an empirical offer rate, temporal availability process, compatibility map, persistence rule, or withdrawal rule. No numeric offer or transfer default can be populated. The ward DES's FIFO ward queues, verified capacities, elective and ED admissions, and counterfactual discharge/clustering scenarios describe its model and interventions; they are not observed ED-facing offers. R29's one-unit finite offer for a compatible destination class, optional transfer-completion interval, and proposed temporal conditioning are a proposed model boundary, not findings or parameter values from Hassanzadeh et al. Any use of that interface before local evidence exists must be labelled as a synthetic scenario assumption and cannot support causal claims about ward discharge, elective scheduling, or bed release mechanisms.

Its ward model included elective and ED admissions, wards with verified capacities, and FIFO ward queues.

Searched the pinned article text for offer, bed offer, availability, eligible bed, compatibility, destination, specialty, transfer, discharge, expiry, withdrawal, weekday, weekend, and season. The text describes ward movement timing, bed capacity, and policy scenarios, but no ED-eligible offer event, compatible destination field, offer denominator, offer persistence/expiry, or withdrawal event. Generic mention of bed availability does not define an offer event.

Compared the separate supplied R29 report lineage, SHA-256 f6764b6e89715404bc494c78aa6a3ea582d3e57f978ca68edf7c4ccbc5aa7db6, lines 27-54 and 200-212.
